header: LOCAL LICENSE AND PERMIT DISCLOSURE — SHORT TERM RENTAL

blocks.text: LOCAL LICENSE AND PERMIT DISCLOSURE — SHORT TERM RENTAL

This License and Permit Disclosure is attached to the Short Term Rental Agreement dated {{agreement_date}} between {{host_name}} ("Host") and {{guest_name}} ("Guest"). This disclosure is provided as required by local short-term rental regulations.

rows: Host Business License / Tax Certificate Number
{{str_registration_authority}} (e.g., NYC Mayor's Office of Special Enforcement, SF Office of Short Term Rentals, FL DBPR)

blocks.text: The following local requirements apply to this rental. Guest acknowledges having been informed of these requirements:

items: JURISDICTION: This rental is located in {{local_jurisdiction}}. Short-term rental regulations in this jurisdiction include: {{local_str_regulations}}
HOST REGISTRATION: Host confirms that the property is registered with the appropriate local authority (if required). STR registration number: {{str_registration_number}}.
MAXIMUM STAY: This property is subject to a maximum stay of {{max_stay_days_local}} consecutive days per local regulation.
MINIMUM AGE: Guests must be at least {{minimum_age_local}} years old (if applicable).
OCCUPANCY LIMIT: The maximum occupancy for this property per local regulation is {{local_occupancy_limit}} persons.
Comply with all local laws, ordinances, and regulations applicable to the Guest's stay.
Pay any occupancy / lodging taxes as required by the Agreement.
Not use the property for any purpose that violates local short-term rental regulations.
Notify Host immediately if Guest becomes aware of any local regulation violation.
Provide accurate identification and registration information as required by local law.

blocks.text: If the property is not in compliance with local STR regulations, or if Host fails to maintain required registrations or permits, Guest may:

items: Receive a full refund of all charges paid.
Be eligible for any remedies available under local law.

blocks.text: However, if the Guest discovers a compliance issue after arrival, Guest must notify Host promptly to allow Host the opportunity to cure the issue.

Guest acknowledges having received and reviewed this Local License and Permit Disclosure. Guest confirms that the property is properly registered and licensed for short-term rental use as required by local law.
